To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a simple, fast and efficient methodology for the extraction of trace metals in different types of natural waters is proposed.
the proposed methodology allows an effective extraction of trace metals Cd, Pp and Ag from natural water samples, even highly saline samples.
the proposed method allows a fast, low cost and green micro-extraction of trace pollutants such Cd, Ag and Pt in natural waters, including saline ones.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new analytical techniques for the extraction of metallic pollutants from natural waters.
the development of a new green methodology for trace metal analysis.
the development of a simple and fast method for trace metal extraction, using a green ionic liquid.

the method is a low cost, fast, easy and green extraction technique for trace metals in natural waters.
the proposed system is an easy and fast method that allows the extraction of trace metals in natural waters including saline samples.
SBME is a green, simple and fast methodology for the extraction of trace metals in saline natural waters.

the proposed methodology is a low-cost and environmentally friendly alternative for the extraction and pre-concentration of trace metallic pollutants in natural waters.
